environment.interface: fastmcp call_tool(session_search), one loop per start

full_receipt.note: recompute the cluster bootstrap from the full file; the committed metrics_sha256 is the FULL receipt's

gate: L (L-astra): resident-state latency for the mcp/web default flip

workload.relaunched: once per start, terminated when that start exits
workload.spin: python integer loop, no allocation and no I/O
